comments.value: At this time I am not entirely sure what can cause a Moderation Report Closed notification to be re-issued with an update, but I suspect it may have something to do with an avatar being reported in two separate categories (Sexual Content / Child exploitation and abuse) and being actioned in only one of these categories or both (because content not actioned generally does not generate a notification and a report is silently closed in `/moderationReports` API from what I understand).

I'm also exceptionally attaching my `GET https://vrchat.com/api/1/moderationReports?status=closed` response (n=50) unredacted publicly here for this bug report for correlation.

I suspect the `updatedAt` event was caused by two reports with the same `contentId`/`contentName`/`contentThumbnailImageUrl`:

- `modReport_77392840-6305-493b-a308-07ac32da37dc` (#6)

- `modReport_95b6d721-a631-4c86-9b75-a4cd05b64bb5` (#7)

There's also a less likely plausibility from:

- `modReport_74459e9c-36bf-4c3a-b08d-44b429b05248`

- `modReport_6a3b67b5-278a-4124-8091-93b05931f056`

details:
I'm resubmitting an older bug report due to age and new information available.

When something triggers a Moderation Report Closed notification to be updated, a new notification for the update is sent out with the same `createdAt` date and an unique `updatedAt` date. At this point in time, the user may have two Moderation Report Closed notifications with identical `createdAt` dates, but unique `updatedAt` dates.

In the example attached `notifications.json` response retrieved from `GET https://vrchat.com/api/1/notifications?limit=100`, notifications #5 and #6 from the top share the same `"createdAt": "2026-07-03T18:00:19.902Z"` date for Moderation Report Closed notifications.

When VRChat `Build 1865` sees these two notifications with identical `createdAt` dates from the API on client launch, it's interpreted as bad response data by `Transmtn.PostOffice.ProcessNotification` for having duplicate `createdAt` keys and notifications older than this never arrive to the client or are never processed by it. Effectively, a "crash" of notifications processing.

Affected notification IDs (identical `createdAt` keys):

- `not_13cf4c6c-6585-443c-af8c-0b0e4ca92867`

- `not_baaa6d95-c41e-4780-adf7-4b4c716cc49f`

Expected result: 34 notifications in VRChat Home (API response) and VRChat `Build 1865`.

Actual result: 34 notifications on VRChat Home (API response), 5 notifications in VRChat `Build 1865` and an inner stack exception in output logs.

Additional info:

- https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/error-api-inner-stack-exception-an-item-with-the-same-key-has-already-been-added

- `/moderationReports?status=closed` response in comments
title: An updated Moderation Report Closed notification causes notifications processor (Transmtn.PostOffice.ProcessNotification) to stop processing older notifications (identical createdAt date keys)
